No supplier agreement in the dataset contains an MFN (most-favoured-nation) pricing clause.

I checked all 21 supplier agreements in `docs/suppliers/` (supplier-agreement-005.docx through -120.docx, plus the named ones: acme, borealis, corvid, dunmore). Each has an identical "Clause 6. Pricing" that is either:
- "Unit prices are fixed for the term and are not indexed," or
- "Unit prices are subject to an indexed price cap, adjusted annually by the consumer price index and capped at four percent."

A grep across all supplier agreement files for MFN-related language ("most favoured/favored nation," "best price," "no less favorable," "other customer," "parity") returned no matches in any clause (1–10) of any document.

**NOT FOUND** — none of the supplier agreements (docs/suppliers/*.docx) contain a most-favoured-nation pricing clause.
